name: ExecuteXPathExpression
label: Execute XPath Expression
description: Executes an XPath expression on the provided XML content and returns the result.

fields.name: XmlContent
fields.label: XML Content
fields.description: The XML content to query with XPath.

fields.name: GetFirstValueOnly
fields.label: Get First Value Only
fields.description: If true, only the first matching node will be returned. If false, all matching nodes will be returned as a list.

fields.name: XPathResult
fields.label: XPath Result
fields.description: Returns the value of the first matching node or null if not found.

fields.name: XPathResults
fields.label: XPath Results
fields.description: Returns all matching nodes as a list of strings.
